### 1. Causal Relationship
The versions are concurrent ($v2 \parallel v3$). 

Neither vector clock dominates the other:
* $v2$ has $[1, 1, 0]$
* $v3$ has $[0, 0, 1]$

$v2$ dominates on indices $A$ and $B$, but $v3$ dominates on index $C$. Because neither $\text{VC}(v2) \le \text{VC}(v3)$ nor $\text{VC}(v3) \le \text{VC}(v2)$ holds, neither update happened before the other.
